organage_somascan.json.clock: organage organ aging models (11 organs + organismal + conventional), SomaScan
organage_somascan.json.source: Oh HS-H, Rutledge J et al. Organ aging signatures in the plasma proteome track health and disease. Nature 2023;624:164-172; package organage (main branch, Copyright (c) 2023 Hamilton Oh)
organage_somascan.json.licence: MIT (LICENSE file of the organage repository)
organage_somascan.json.derivation: validation/build_organage_coefs.py: the 500 bootstrap Lasso models per organ are averaged into one linear model (exact for linear models); protein z-score scalers, age-gap scaler and the training-cohort lowess (interp1d, linear, extrapolate) are copied as numbers. Pickles were read with a restricted unpickler that executes no code. Coefficients with zero bootstrap mean are dropped (no effect on predictions).
organage_somascan.json.inputs: SomaScan ANML-normalised RFU; v4.1 native; v4 and v5 rescaled to v4.1 with the package's per-SeqId factors; log10; z-score with the KADRC healthy-control scaler; Sex_F as first feature
organage_somascan.json.outputs: LP:prot.organage_<organ>_gap = predicted organ age - lowess(chronological age) of the training cohort (years); agegap_z = gap / SD(gap) in training cohort

not_implemented.Olink organ clocks (Oh HS-H et al. Nat M: Licence of the original coefficient release not verified; biolearn's BSD licence covers biolearn's code, not necessarily third-party coefficient tables. Not implemented.
not_implemented.SomaScan cross-version bridging other th: Not implemented; v4/v5 are rescaled only with the factors shipped by organage.

passthrough.seqid_source: SomaScan_V4.0_5K_Annotated_Content_20210616.csv as shipped in the organage repository
